instruction: Could you disable the dark color scheme currently active in Chrome's interface?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome's active color scheme (dark vs light) is controlled by multiple factors including OS-level dark mode settings, Chrome theme settings, and chrome://flags configurations. There is no reliable way to programmatically verify the current UI color scheme without complex screenshot analysis or accessing Chrome's internal state which varies across versions and platforms.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly uses 'infeasible' evaluator function which exists in the metrics module
Metadata provides technically accurate explanation of why verification is infeasible
Chrome's color scheme verification is indeed unreliable due to multiple interdependent factors (OS dark mode, Chrome themes, chrome://flags)
Marking task as infeasible is semantically appropriate - better to acknowledge verification limitations than provide flawed evaluator
No programmatic way to reliably verify UI color scheme without complex screenshot analysis across different Chrome versions and platforms
